title: How Significant Are the Real Performance Gains? An Unbiased Evaluation Framework for GraphRAG

bias_targets.methodology: Swapping the order of two compared answers in the LLM evaluation prompt (e.g., 'AB' to 'BA') to measure the disparity in win rates that favor the answer presented first.
Comparing the win rates of answers with different lengths generated by the same method to demonstrate the LLM judge's disproportionate preference for longer responses.

Repeating the evaluation of the same model pairs multiple times across the same set of questions to quantify the variance, instability, and contradictory conclusions caused by LLM generation randomness.
